review_scope: Five new full reusables read; every scalar/navigation sentence and conditional scope claim accounted separately. Prior nested organization navigation and paid-plan fragments not duplicated. External MCP governance and enterprise-policy pages still require independent review. No applied settings, rights clearance, adoption or omission certification.

claims.statement: An enterprise-selected Copilot policy cannot be overridden by an organization; local policy choice does not prove effective enforcement.
Enterprise policy choices include everywhere enabled, everywhere disabled and selected organizations only; inherited target scope must be preserved.
The reusable supplies the Code, planning, and automation sidebar label only; it is navigation, not a security or role guarantee.
The cloud-agent settings fragment composes sidebar/Copilot/Cloud agent navigation and an additional sidebar-label reusable; no setting is applied by reading it.
Copilot's MCP servers policy covers uses where MCP support is generally available; preview availability must be reviewed independently.
That Copilot policy does not control access or permissions for GitHub MCP server in third-party hosts such as Cursor, Windsurf or Claude.
GitHub MCP server's separate policies/governance document supplies its control mechanisms; its linked current/main file is not reviewed by this reusable.
Feedback collection opt-in displays opportunities for users to provide feedback on selected Copilot features; it does not specify model-training authorization.
Preview opt-in permits testing features not generally available.
Preview features may contain flaws and may change or be discontinued at any time; opt-in does not certify stability or protection coverage.
